Thank you for sending the notice. We have asked Vellora's registered billing team (billing@vellora.example) to confirm whether notice CH-028 for GBP 74 is genuine and, if so, how it should be paid.

Vellora's records currently show no matching charge, and the hold on your parcel is recorded as a broker review. Until billing confirms, please don't pay through the link or address in the notice, and don't share card or bank details with anyone.

We cannot make payments for you. We will update you here once billing replies. This message is an update, not a confirmation of release or of any charge.

Rivet Delivery Desk
